# Do the staff spreadsheets reconcile with Neon?

Three records exist of FY26 appeal giving. They measure different things at
different times; Neon (pulled July 2026, after the campaign closed) is the
source of truth for every response flag in this site.

```{python}
#| label: setup-recon
import pandas as pd
from hh.clean.accounts import clean_accounts
from hh.clean.donations import clean_donations
from hh.external.appeal import appeal_load_qa, load_appeal_sheets
from hh.analytics.appeal import reconcile_eoy_export
from hh.io import read_parquet
from hh.viz import money, pct

rec = read_parquet("processed", "appeal_recipients.parquet")
t = read_parquet("processed", "appeal_households.parquet")
eoy = read_parquet("processed", "eoy_export_gifts.parquet")
qa = appeal_load_qa(load_appeal_sheets(), rec)
```

## Three totals

```{python}
totals = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "source": [
            "appeal workbook ('Annual Appeal Donation' column)",
            "End-of-year export (gifts through Jan 7)",
            "Neon pull, July 2026 (campaign, Oct 1 – Jan 31, SUCCEEDED)",
        ],
        "gifts": [int(rec["appeal_gift_recorded"].notna().sum()), len(eoy), int(t["afd_n_gifts"].sum())],
        "dollars": [qa["recorded_gift_total"], eoy["donation_amount"].sum(), t["afd_amount"].sum()],
    }
)
totals["dollars"] = totals["dollars"].map(money)
totals
```

Mechanical differences between the cuts:

- the export stops January 7, 2026; the workbook column and Neon include later January gifts
- Neon excludes canceled gifts; the workbook column includes whatever staff recorded
- `{python} f"{int((t['responded'] & ~t['appealed']).sum())}"` households gave to the campaign
  without being on the mailing list (next section names them)
- the workbook credits `{python} f"{qa['missing_id_with_recorded_gift']}"` donors who have no
  Neon id anywhere on their row (below)

## Appeal-list load QA

What was dropped when cleaning the workbook's `{python} f"{sum(qa['rows_read'].values()):,}"` raw rows:

```{python}
load_qa = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "sheet": list(qa["rows_read"]),
        "rows read": list(qa["rows_read"].values()),
        "subtotal/Total/placeholder/blank dropped": list(qa["rows_dropped"].values()),
        "exact duplicates dropped": list(qa["duplicate_rows"].values()),
        "rows kept": [qa["rows_kept"].get(s, 0) for s in qa["rows_read"]],
    }
)
load_qa
```

Kept rows: `{python} f"{len(rec):,}"`, covering `{python} f"{qa['unique_account_ids']:,}"`
unique Neon accounts.

## Recipients with no Neon id

These rows have a name (and for some, a recorded gift) but no account id, no
household id, no address, and no email — they cannot be linked to Neon as-is.

```{python}
no_id = rec[rec["missing_account_id"]][
    ["workbook_name", "source_sheet", "appeal_segment", "appeal_gift_recorded"]
].rename(
    columns={
        "workbook_name": "household", "source_sheet": "sheet",
        "appeal_segment": "segment", "appeal_gift_recorded": "recorded gift",
    }
).reset_index(drop=True)
no_id["recorded gift"] = no_id["recorded gift"].map(money)
no_id
```

## Recipient accounts that no longer exist in Neon

```{python}
accounts = clean_accounts()
donations = clean_donations(accounts=accounts)
missing_acct = rec[rec["account_id"].notna() & ~rec["account_id"].isin(set(accounts["account_id"]))]
missing_acct = missing_acct[
    ["workbook_name", "source_sheet", "workbook_hhid", "appeal_gift_recorded"]
].rename(
    columns={
        "workbook_name": "household", "source_sheet": "sheet",
        "workbook_hhid": "workbook hhid", "appeal_gift_recorded": "recorded gift",
    }
).reset_index(drop=True)
missing_acct["recorded gift"] = missing_acct["recorded gift"].map(money)
missing_acct
```

`{python} f"{len(missing_acct)}"` recipient rows point at accounts that were deleted or
merged away in Neon. Where the workbook's household id still names a live household,
the household-level table keeps them through that fallback.

## End-of-year export vs Neon

```{python}
r = reconcile_eoy_export(eoy, donations, accounts)
match_counts = r["match_method"].value_counts().rename_axis("match method").reset_index(name="gifts")
match_counts
```

Every export row matched a Neon account —
`{python} f"{int((r['match_method'] == 'email').sum())}"` by email,
`{python} f"{int((r['match_method'] == 'name-zip').sum())}"` by first+last name and ZIP.
But `{python} f"{int(r['neon_afd_n_gifts'].isna().sum())}"` matched households show **no**
campaign gift in Neon's window — those gifts are recorded under a different campaign
(or the gift is missing from Neon). They are:

```{python}
odd = r[r["matched_rollup_id"].notna() & r["neon_afd_n_gifts"].isna()]
odd = odd[
    ["donor_first", "donor_last", "donation_date", "donation_amount", "source", "matched_rollup_id"]
].rename(
    columns={
        "donor_first": "first", "donor_last": "last", "donation_date": "date",
        "donation_amount": "export amount", "source": "source", "matched_rollup_id": "neon household",
    }
).reset_index(drop=True)
odd["export amount"] = odd["export amount"].map(money)
odd
```

And the export rows that matched a household **not on the appeal list**:

```{python}
not_on_list = r[r["matched_rollup_id"].isin(set(t.loc[~t["appealed"], "id"]))]
not_on_list = not_on_list[
    ["donor_first", "donor_last", "donation_date", "donation_amount", "neon_afd_amount"]
].rename(
    columns={
        "donor_first": "first", "donor_last": "last", "donation_date": "date",
        "donation_amount": "export amount", "neon_afd_amount": "neon campaign gifts in window",
    }
).reset_index(drop=True)
not_on_list["export amount"] = not_on_list["export amount"].map(money)
not_on_list
```
